about_the_game:
Otto receives a mysterious phone call that leads him to his family’s killer. To uncover the truth, he must complete a series of trials that distort his perception of reality.

Guided by an entity called the Operator, he navigates strange events, faces threats, and uncovers hidden clues. With each trials, the lines between past and present blur, forcing him to question what is real. His choices shape the outcome—will he find the truth or lose himself in the process?


Warning: Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition.

  • Two Perspectives, One Nightmare

Switch between first-person gameplay and top-down exploration. Each view presents different challenges, requiring quick thinking and adaptation.

  • A Distinctive Vision

Explore a world with a unique art style and atmospheric storytelling. Every scene holds a clue, and every shadow hides something unknown.

  • Nightmares Made Flesh

Encounter supernatural entities lurking in the dark—some recognizable, others impossible to understand… and maybe even a few clowns to make things worse.

  • Retro-Tech Horror Vibes

A robotic text-to-speech voice, inspired by classic S.A.M. synthesis, adds an eerie and nostalgic feel to every interaction.

  • A Protagonist Worth Watching

Play as a lead character who isn’t just smart and determined—but also easy on the eyes.
